scripts.hydrate: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run gen
scripts.hydrate:web-slicer: pnpm run build:wasm:web-slicer && pnpm run gen
scripts.ios:init: scripts/ios-doctor.sh && pnpm --filter slicer-ui-desktop exec tauri ios init
scripts.ios:open: pnpm --filter slicer-ui-desktop exec tauri ios dev --open
scripts.ios:build: pnpm --filter slicer-ui-desktop exec tauri ios build
scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/slicer_engine.wasm --target web --out-dir ui/src/generated/scene-wasm --out-name scene_engine
scripts.build:wasm:web-slicer: cargo build --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release --features web-slicer && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/slicer_engine.wasm --target web --out-dir ui/src/generated/scene-wasm --out-name scene_engine
scripts.gen: pnpm run gen-schemas && pnpm run gen-types
